description: Tempo 30-Zonen Stadt St.Gallen is a dataset listed in Stadt St.Gallen open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Rauminformationszentrum (RIZ) Stadt St.Gallen. Realisierte Tempo 30-Zonen, mit Angabe Gebiet, Nr. und Einführungsdatum. Coverage: St. Gallen. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Geschwindigkeit, MIV, Strassen, Langsamverkehr. The portal shows 90 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-daten-stadt-sg-ch-portal.
